scope: Frontend feature consolidation, question-solving usability, safe answer retry, and bounded research replay proxy timeout

full_browser_suite.runtime: Next.js standalone production build; isolated QA MongoDB database
coverage: Desktop/tablet/mobile student navigation and local fonts
Registration, onboarding, diagnostic skip/save/resume/report and mobile practice feedback
Four student destinations and working legacy revision/history links

Practice draft and working restoration after reload, offline/online controls, deliberately lost server confirmation, same-ID locked-selection retry, single saved attempt, six-question completion and review
Fixed selected-answer save before leaving and question navigation
Teacher analytics navigation, paper creation/assignment, student submission, withheld score, teacher close/release and student report
Administrator numeric question publishing, pseudonymous data export, BKT replay, cold HiTSKT replay and research audit view

final_layout_checks.command: PLAYWRIGHT_CHANNEL=msedge npx playwright test design.spec.ts usability.spec.ts
final_layout_checks.includes: Feedback-bottom <= action-footer-top assertion on mobile; screenshot review after final CSS correction

resolved_findings: Repeated student practice/revision, report/history and account navigation
Adaptive mock placement confused practice with formal exams
Selected fixed-paper answer could be lost on leave or navigation
Practice choices and answer states were too small or visually ambiguous
Uncertain answer retry could be associated with a changed visible selection
Cold HiTSKT loading exceeded the default 30-second web proxy timeout; direct warm replay returned the verified output
Mobile sticky action footer could overlap feedback; replaced with normal flow and a geometry assertion
limits: Expert review and functional checks, not a measured usability study
Unchecked practice drafts are limited to the current browser tab when session storage is available
Live mathematics remains on BKT; HiTSKT uses a separate research fixture
